items.description: A concise, genuinely additional Chinese meaning not already supplied; omit paraphrases and filler.
A correct natural English example using the source word, phrase, or a normal inflection; never an intentionally wrong example.

similarWords.description: Together with confusableWords, return at most three learnable candidates in total.

word.description: One correctly formed standard-English synonym or near-synonym headword or grammatical phrase; no error form, comparison label, or explanation.

differenceZh.description: A concise Chinese explanation of the genuine usage difference.

confusableWords.description: Together with similarWords, return at most three learnable candidates in total.

word.description: One correctly formed standard-English headword or grammatical phrase genuinely confusable with the source; no misspelling, malformed expression, comparison label, or explanation.

differenceZh.description: A concise Chinese explanation of the genuine difference without teaching the candidate as an error form.

items.description: Either no examples or one correct source sentence plus one correct candidate sentence; no wrong-form demonstration or correctness label.
